cites.quote: `lists the patient's appointments`, upcoming first, then past.
A past appointment the patient did not attend
An appointment called off before it took place, with a reason
Completed and No-show are allowed only `after the start time`.
`Medical history` appears only on the patient's own page
An appointment called off before it took place
Given a patient with a Completed appointment, when staff select the Last visit date, then the page of that appointment opens.

findings.suggested_fix: Reuse the S-3 AC3 data: selecting the Last visit date opens the 01 Nov 2026 appointment with Dr A, not the 01 Oct one, the No-show, the Cancelled one or the Scheduled one.
findings.text: S-3 AC4 has a patient with one Completed appointment, so a link to any other appointment of the patient (for example the most recent one of any status, or the first table row) still passes. The AC does not prove REQ-10's 'that appointment'.

cites.quote: title: Summary stays free of sensitive details and nothing else changes

findings.suggested_fix: Split S-5 into a privacy story (AC1, AC2) and a no-regression story (AC3 to AC5).
findings.text: Previous F-3 is still open: S-5 bundles two independent outcomes, no sensitive details in the summary (REQ-13) and no change anywhere else (REQ-14). The resolves list does not mention it.

cites.quote: more appointments than the patient page's Appointments table loads
the patient page's appointment list is loaded with a row limit

findings.suggested_fix: Cite the row limit from the product code and state the count inline, for example limit + 1 appointments.
findings.text: Previous F-4 is still open: S-2 AC2 depends on the Appointments table's row limit but does not name it, so a tester must look up the limit before building the test data.

cites.quote: then each looks and behaves as before and shows no Visit summary

findings.suggested_fix: State the observable check, for example: no 'Visit summary' text appears and the existing regression tests for these pages still pass.
findings.text: Previous F-5 is still open: S-5 AC5 says 'looks and behaves as before' across five pages and names no check a tester can observe.

cites.quote: 1 Scheduled appointment whose start time has already passed and that staff have not closed yet
Scheduled appointments that start after now

findings.suggested_fix: Have the past Scheduled appointment in S-1 AC3 start earlier today, for example one hour before now, so it is not counted as upcoming.
findings.text: S-1 AC3 does not say when the past Scheduled appointment started. If it is on an earlier day, an upcoming count that compares dates (start date >= today) still passes AC3 and AC4, even though REQ-5 compares against now.

rubric_items.reason: All 14 known REQs are traced: REQ-1..5,7 in S-1, REQ-6 in S-2, REQ-8..11 in S-3, REQ-12 in S-4, REQ-13..14 in S-5. The intent has no assumed REQs.
S-1 to S-4 each deliver one outcome. S-5 still bundles the privacy constraint (REQ-13) with the no-regression constraint (REQ-14). The previous F-3 is not addressed.

Previous F-1 and F-2 are fixed: S-1 AC5 excludes a future Cancelled appointment, and S-3 AC3 proves the most recent Completed visit is chosen. S-3 AC4 still cannot catch a link to the wrong appointment.
Values come from the intent, A-01 and the glossary. The UTC+05:30 shift is derived inline from C1. Dates and counts are test data, not invented limits.
Terms are clear and match the glossary. S-5 AC5 still uses the loose 'looks and behaves as before', and S-2 AC2 leaves the table's row limit unnamed.
